svg.title: Four Checks Before Production Access
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-preflight-risk-decisions; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Checks Before Production Access; subtitle: Each failed branch has a concrete remediation path.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values identify ordered checks, not probabilities or risk scores. A passing branch proceeds to the next check; a failing branch pauses the affected activity. Statutory applicability depends on the client and data.; caption: Keep written access authorization, applicable processing terms, deliverable rights, and evaluation evidence in the engagement record. Use synthetic data while unresolved production dependencies are corrected.; stages: label: Authorized system access?; value: Yes: scope credentials; no: remain in the sandbox; numeric value: 1.0; detail: 18 U.S.C. 1030 addresses unauthorized access and exceeding authorized access. Record the client's authority, named systems, permitted operations, credential expiry, and revocation owner before connecting any production service account.; label: Permitted data processing?; value: Yes: minimize data; no: repair contracts and routing; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Where applicable, California Civil Code 1798.100(d) requires specified disclosure-contract terms. For HIPAA business-associate work, apply 45 CFR 164.504(e) contracts and 164.312 technical safeguards. Document subprocessors, retention, deletion, and permitted destinations before transmitting client data.; label: Usable input and output rights?; value: Yes: record licenses; no: replace restricted materials; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Inventory client inputs, reusable agency components, and third-party dependencies. Under 17 U.S.C. 204(a), copyright ownership transfers generally require a signed writing. Assign or license rights actually held; do not promise exclusive ownership of every model-generated artifact.; label: Supported claims and safe execution?; value: Yes: limited release; no: revise claims or workflow; numeric value: 4.0; detail: 15 U.S.C. 45 prohibits unfair or deceptive practices. Retain evidence for advertised performance under stated conditions. As operating controls, require human review for consequential decisions, test prompt-injection resistance, and verify rollback.

circle.title: label: Authorized system access?; value: Yes: scope credentials; no: remain in the sandbox; numeric value: 1.0; detail: 18 U.S.C. 1030 addresses unauthorized access and exceeding authorized access. Record the client's authority, named systems, permitted operations, credential expiry, and revocation owner before connecting any production service account.

text.title: 18 U.S.C. 1030 addresses unauthorized access and exceeding authorized access. Record the client's authority, named systems, permitted operations, credential expiry, and revocation owner before connecting any production service account.

circle.title: label: Permitted data processing?; value: Yes: minimize data; no: repair contracts and routing; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Where applicable, California Civil Code 1798.100(d) requires specified disclosure-contract terms. For HIPAA business-associate work, apply 45 CFR 164.504(e) contracts and 164.312 technical safeguards. Document subprocessors, retention, deletion, and permitted destinations before transmitting client data.

text.title: Where applicable, California Civil Code 1798.100(d) requires specified disclosure-contract terms. For HIPAA business-associate work, apply 45 CFR 164.504(e) contracts and 164.312 technical safeguards. Document subprocessors, retention, deletion, and permitted destinations before transmitting client data.

circle.title: label: Usable input and output rights?; value: Yes: record licenses; no: replace restricted materials; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Inventory client inputs, reusable agency components, and third-party dependencies. Under 17 U.S.C. 204(a), copyright ownership transfers generally require a signed writing. Assign or license rights actually held; do not promise exclusive ownership of every model-generated artifact.

text.title: Inventory client inputs, reusable agency components, and third-party dependencies. Under 17 U.S.C. 204(a), copyright ownership transfers generally require a signed writing. Assign or license rights actually held; do not promise exclusive ownership of every model-generated artifact.

circle.title: label: Supported claims and safe execution?; value: Yes: limited release; no: revise claims or workflow; numeric value: 4.0; detail: 15 U.S.C. 45 prohibits unfair or deceptive practices. Retain evidence for advertised performance under stated conditions. As operating controls, require human review for consequential decisions, test prompt-injection resistance, and verify rollback.

text.title: 15 U.S.C. 45 prohibits unfair or deceptive practices. Retain evidence for advertised performance under stated conditions. As operating controls, require human review for consequential decisions, test prompt-injection resistance, and verify rollback.

Assumptions: Numeric values identify ordered checks, not probabilities or risk scores. A passing branch proceeds to the next check; a failing branch pauses the affected activity. Statutory applicability depends on the client and data.
